svg.title: Triangular mesh refinement for f(x, y) = x² + y²
svg.desc: The unit square is split into two triangles. Each triangle splits into four at its edge midpoints, giving 2, 8, 32, 128 and 512 triangles. The six-second loop pauses on the finest mesh before restarting. Mesh vertices lie on the function surface. This illustrates refinement, not measured integration error or runtime.
